值得閱讀的理由

  • 深入了解《遊戲王》經典神卡「太陽神之翼神龍」從原作至尊地位走向實卡大幅弱化，再由官方逐步透過支援卡「還原神威」的演變歷程。
  • 解析最新系列如何重現馬利克的顏藝與經典戰術，包括無視對手全抗性的「選格子」解場效果與破萬攻擊力的一回殺（OTK）爆發機制。
  • 為熱愛經典卡牌的收藏家提供老卡保值情懷分析，以及作者在二手市場尋找懷舊卡牌的實戰經驗與平台建議。

摘要

神之威嚴與實卡化的尷尬落差

作者首先提到《遊戲王》中的反派馬利克以其豐富生動的表情控制成為迷因界的常客，而他身為太陽神之翼神龍的原持有者，更展現了神級怪獸的崇高與絕對力量。在原作設定中，翼神龍具備全抗性、需詠唱咒文召喚，且能透過墓地復活將生命值支付至一分轉化為攻擊力進行 OTK（一回殺），甚至能以千分生命值灼燒任何怪獸。然而，實卡化後的翼神龍卻遭到嚴重削弱，失去了抗性與繼承祭品攻擊力的能力，甚至無法特殊召喚，淪為三幻神中表現最弱的卡片。

配件救贖與不拋棄舊卡的情懷設計

為彌補實卡遺憾，官方陸續推出如球體形、不死鳥及「古之咒文」、「千年的啟示」等輔助魔陷，將原作各種威能以散裝零件的方式逐步補全，使翼神龍超越其他兩幻神，自成獨立體系。而在最新的卡包設計中，官方不僅重現了馬利克的招牌戰術，更堅持保留原版翼神龍為核心運作條件，並未因為時代演進而淘汰老卡，這讓許多深具情懷的老玩家大受感動，紛紛翻出童年收藏重返戰場。

老卡尋寶途徑與二手交易技巧

作者坦言自己是偏好保留舊卡價值的懷舊型玩家，但在實體社團中老卡不僅稀有且價格常被炒得極高。面對一卡難求的困境，作者分享可以轉向日本大型二手交易平台 Mercari 尋找卡牌，該平台不僅擁有龐大的卡牌專區便於比價，官方亦提供檢驗轉運機制。作者同時提醒，挑選賣家時應優先選擇認證合格、評價高且交易量大的店鋪，並詳閱商品照片與說明，避免因貪小便宜而受騙。

回到卡牌戰術面，新卡透過融合馬利克形象的專用怪獸與專屬法術展開，不僅自身具備不受其他卡片效果影響的完整抗性，更設計了繞過對手抗性的強制送墓效果——透過玩家指定對手怪獸格子，逼迫對手將該區域的卡片送入墓地，達成「我不動你的神，我動你神腳下的地板」之霸道解場。在進攻端，此卡在攻擊宣言時能支付生命值至一分，將所付數值及墓地中翼神龍原攻擊力全數加總，攻擊力輕易突破萬點，再搭配戰鬥破壞給予對手原攻擊力數值的追加效果傷害，完美重現原作中如同黑暗決鬥般直接對玩家造成精神重創的毀滅性 OTK 終結技。

The third effect is a powered-up version of its ultimate move from the original series. During the attack declaration in battle, you can pay your Life Points until you have only 1 left; this card gains ATK and DEF equal to the amount paid, plus the combined original ATK of all "The Winged Dragon of Ra" monsters in your graveyard. . This number easily exceeds 10,000, and with complete immunity, getting hit basically means it's game over. by battle, the controller takes damage equal to the monster's original ATK. This is quite strong and perfect for finishing off the opponent. Furthermore, if you use this effect to summon a monster during the opponent's turn, you can special summon another monster. We can use this effect to bring out Ra's Disciple, and since the Disciple sets one card, we can find Immortal Phoenix and immediately jump it out to burn the opponent. Alternatively, use the Slime to search for Egyptian God Feast, which.

acts as a hand trap. Since the Slime itself is an "Egyptian God" card, meeting this condition is easy. Speaking of which, this is the monster that locked up Mai Valentine in the original series; my friend says this "system" is totally fixed, but I don't get what that means. While an Egyptian God monster is on the field, you select one monster from each Graveyard to special summon to your field; if you have The Winged Dragon of Ra, you take control of all monsters your opponent controls. This. also pays homage to the original, where Mai stole The Winged Dragon of Ra and tributed three monsters to summon it, but in the end, they were unable to... Mai couldn't read the incantation, so the God refused to cooperate with her. Later, Marik took the field himself to recite the chant and reclaimed The Winged Dragon of Ra, leaving Mai with no monsters, which is why the card has that "NTR" reputation. The second effect of this card lets you banish one Egyptian God monster from your Graveyard to have your Life Points recover equal to that monster's ATK, reflecting the anime scene where the fusion was undone. It acts as the final line of defense. Even though it has full protection, players are still afraid of taking sudden damage , so this life recovery actually has its. merits. Next is the Ra's Disciple—the new Ra fusion. You send a Ra monster and two face-up monsters to the Graveyard to Special Summon this card to the opponent's Main Monster Zone. Since all our monsters are Ra monsters, it's very easy to perform contact fusion with the opponent's monsters, making it a very strong removal tool. Basically, just put it in the Extra Deck like a Kaiju; there's no need to search for it, just use it whenever you want. Finally, there's the Ra monster version of the Koa'ki Meiru. It’s an Effect Monster version; check the effect yourself. It’s more of a utility piece, so running one copy is fine for now. To make it easier to remember, let’s chain the effects. together. Assuming we have Hell Guardians plus any random card in hand, discard one to Special Summon Hell Guardians. When Hell Guardians enter the field, search for True Ra, then activate True Ra to grab the Flame Guard. Then, activate it to send the Winged Dragon of Ra to the Graveyard. Next, use the effect to grab Marik, then Normal Summon Marik. When Marik enters the field, set the Slime. The Slime can be activated immediately because Marik brings it out to Special Summon and adds a Ra card. Here we find the Immortal Ra, then.

activate it to revive the Winged Dragon . Then activate the effect, using True Ra to change its form. Next, overlay the Immortal Bird and the Slime to bring out the Aris Xyz monster , giving us a three-color negate. Then use Hell Guardians and Marik to Link Summon the Silver Magician. When the Silver Magician enters, set a second Slime from the deck, and that’s the end . Finally, in the End Phase, this system has a strong recovery effect. If an Immortal Ra was sent to the Graveyard this turn, all these archetype monsters can return to your hand during the End Phase, so you can recover the Hell. Guardians and Marik from the Graveyard. Once it's the opponent's turn, you can activate the Slime. Then Special Summon Marik, and bring Marik onto the field. When Marik enters, set the Immortal Ra. Let’s review what we have: first, a three-color negate, and the Immortal Ra in the backrow can revive the Winged Dragon, immediately entering battle mode . And this is a fully protected monster . You can discard an archetype card from your hand as a Quick Effect to send the opponent’s monster to the Graveyard. As long as we have True Ra on the field, the opponent cannot attack unless they are also playing the Winged Dragon. In short, our goal is clear: just survive. this turn. Assuming we succeed and the opponent has no answer, during the End Phase, our Ra can discard a Ra card to retrieve a Ra from the graveyard, then summon it to transition into its Dragon form. That should be enough for the kill . That covers this Ra support. Overall, I really like this design; it perfectly realizes Marik's main tactic from the original series of repeatedly reviving Ra, while still preserving the strategic value of the older cards. It’s not just worth including, it’s mandatory. The effects are modern enough to keep up and compete with others. Compared to the other two Gods, this treatment is. top-tier. I highly recommend it.

值得閱讀的理由

  • 回顧《遊戲王 GX》中，十代因決鬥挫敗而失去信心，並在宇宙中重新找回初心的離奇故事。
  • 整理六位新宇俠的特色、令人印象深刻的效果，以及接觸融合與進化形態的設計。
  • 從角色外型、卡片效果到作品梗，了解新宇俠系列為何讓玩家又愛又恨。

摘要

十代失去信心，與新宇俠相遇

十代在命運英雄與元素英雄的對決中敗給愛德，信心崩潰，甚至出現只能看見空白卡面的狀況。他離開學院後遭遇隕石，被帶往宇宙，並遇上一隻會說話的海豚。海豚告訴他，當光明的力量變得邪惡，英雄就必須挺身而出，而十代正是被選中的孩子。

在海豚引導下，十代獲得新牌組，也恢復了看見卡片文字的能力。作者接著揭露，這些新宇俠其實源自十代小時候畫下的英雄：海馬瀨人曾舉辦徵稿活動，並將十代投稿的設計送往宇宙，讓它們吸收宇宙能量，最後成為活生生的怪獸。看著童年創作，十代重新想起自己最初享受決鬥的純粹心情，不再只被勝負壓力牽著走。

接觸融合與新宇俠的特色

十代以新牌組展現自己的決鬥方式，並開始使用接觸融合：不必使用融合，依照怪獸效果便能讓元素英雄新宇俠與新宇宙人合體。這些融合怪獸在回合結束時會返回額外牌組，彷彿呼應英雄只在最後三分鐘出場拯救世界的特攝作品橋段。

作者將焦點放在六位新宇宙人：水波海豚、火焰甲蟲、光輝青苔、天空蜂鳥、黑暗豹與大地鼴鼠，分別對應六種基本屬性。其中最令玩家頭痛的是大地鼴鼠，它與對手怪獸戰鬥時能讓雙方回到手牌，使辛苦召喚出的怪獸輕易被彈回；而天空蜂鳥則會依照對手手牌數量回復生命值。

天空蜂鳥融合成元素英雄天空新宇俠後，效果卻鼓勵十代在生命值較低時提高攻擊力，與蜂鳥的回復能力形成矛盾。作者也提到風屬性的元素英雄羽翼俠多年來在相關商品與插畫中屢遭缺席，讓這位角色顯得格外可憐。

水波海豚與進化形態

最受討論的新宇宙人之一，是能查看對手手牌的水波海豚。牠有海豚頭、健壯的人類身體，還總穿著鞋子，加上說話自然、態度有時頗為傲慢，因此在日本網路上得到帶有嘲諷意味的綽號。雖然實卡效果不像動畫中那樣能無限丟牌，但在手坑盛行的環境裡，查看並處理低攻擊力手牌怪獸，仍讓牠具有戰術價值。

除了六位新宇宙人，還有對應的幼年型態「繭狀怪獸」，能在符合條件時召喚相應的新宇宙人。作者也介紹魔法卡「NEX」：將表側的新宇宙人送入墓地，便能從額外牌組特殊召喚同名的四星進化形態。水波海豚可進化成海洋海豚，而海洋海豚在場上也視為水波海豚，之後還能與新宇俠進行接觸融合，成為元素英雄海洋新宇俠。

不過，NEX 的進化路線最後只推出海豚與黑暗豹兩種，其餘新宇宙人沒有對應進化卡，讓這套原本似乎預備拓展成完整系列的構想中途停擺。影片末段則轉入卡包與商品宣傳，並以玩笑口吻推薦一款主打免手操作與多種模式的產品；原字幕在介紹尚未結束時便中斷。

================================================

Yu-Gi-Oh! GX has a truly wild storyline . During the Civil War between Destiny Heroes and Elemental Heroes, Jaden lost to Aster, shattering his confidence and causing selective blindness—he couldn't read his cards, seeing only blank spaces . This was serious; it was like a chef losing their sense of taste or a psychic losing their powers, leading Jaden into a deep depression. He sailed away from the Academy, drifting aimlessly until he was struck by a meteorite, transported into space, and met a talking dolphin who asked, "Do you believe in the light ?" The dolphin explained that this world. has light and dark, but when the power of light expands and turns evil, heroes must rise to the challenge, and Jaden is the chosen child. Guided by the dolphin , Jaden received a brand new deck. A miracle occurred, the text reappeared, and he could see again because he had a past connection to these cards. When Jaden was young, Seto Kaiba had a bold idea: he needed the imagination of children, combined with cosmic energy, to create new cards. He launched a " contest," and Jaden, seeing the news, drew the heroes he envisioned as Duel Monsters and submitted them to the Kaiba.

Corporation. Kaiba actually sent the cards into space to absorb cosmic energy —don't ask why—and through "science," they became living beings, like Neos and the Neo-Spacians, which make up his new deck. Looking at the monsters he drew as a child, Jaden began to realize... He had been too obsessed with winning, letting dueling pressure cloud his judgment, forgetting the initial thrill and losing his childlike purity. " Dandelion,""Neo-Spacian Dolphin"—I was so simple-minded back then! Jaden then used these cards to show the audience what true purity is, and what a deck. without "once per turn" effects looks like. He used Neo-Spacian Air Hummingbird to empty his opponent's hand , showed off his skills, was transported back to the real world, and began using Contact Fusion. This is the core summoning mechanic for the Neo-Spacians , a type of Fusion Summoning that requires no Polymerization. All you need to do is follow the monster's text to perform the summon. While similar summoning methods existed during the DM era, they were just called Special Summons back then. It wasn't until GX that the anime officially termed it " Contact Fusion." For more details, see the previous video on Elemental HERO Flare Neos; I won't repeat it here.

Contact Fusion in this era mainly involves Elemental HERO Neos fusing with Neo-Spacians to transform into different forms of Fusion Monsters. These Fusion Monsters have a unique design: they have a time limit. During the End Phase, their mandatory effect returns them to the Extra Deck, which fits the narrative that the heroes Jaden loved as a child only appeared in the final three minutes . Although not explicitly named, the concept of a space hero saving the world in three minutes clearly references Ultraman. Returning to the deck feels just like the three-minute timer flashing, a detail many players have always enjoyed. However, Neos has way. too much lore to cover. If I kept going , you’d be late for work or school tomorrow. So, to be considerate, I’ll focus on the Neo-Spacians in this episode, keep Neos as a supporting character, and dedicate a separate video to him later. The Neo-Spacians include Aqua Dolphin, Flame Scarab, Glow Moss, Air Hummingbird, Dark Panther, and Grand Mole, totaling six monsters, which perfectly match the six basic attributes . Let’s start with the most distinct one : Neo-Spacian Grand Mole. At the start of the Damage Step when it battles an opponent's monster, both return to the hand. That’s right, it doesn't die. This.

was incredibly annoying early on. Imagine spending all your resources to summon a monster, only for your opponent to Normal Summon a Grand Mole and bounce it back. You have to start over, and just when you think you're safe, they do it again next turn. It’s infuriating and makes it one of the most hated monsters in the series. The highest-ranking one is Air Hummingbird. This monster can recover your Life Points based on the number of cards in your opponent's hand . The more cards they have, the more you heal. But its unique feature isn't just this effect; it's the Fusion form,. Elemental HERO Air Neos. Its real effect increases its ATK by the difference between your Life Points and your opponent's when yours are lower. We want our Life Points as low as possible to unleash its full power. This contradicts the Hummingbird’s effect. Hummingbird heals you, but Air Neos needs you to be at low health—it’s totally contradictory . I don't know why they designed it this way. Regarding Elemental HERO Avian, it hasn't been reprinted for years due to external factors. For instance, looking at the recent JUMP packs in the card database, they feature the five basic Elemental HERO forms—Earth, Water, Rock , Light, and Dark—but specifically.

exclude the Wind-attribute Avian. The official team deliberately avoids including him in other card illustrations; he's completely omitted, which is quite pitiful. Since we're already on this page, here's a routine promotion. The latest PH card pack is now available for purchase in the card shop. This one focuses on Marik's deck, featuring the classic Ra's Disciple. It has received a massive buff, offering both competitive strength and nostalgia . Mai's Amazoness and Harpie cards have been merged into a single system; the card art and power level are both great , and I really want to play them. Also, this set's key card, "Insect Queen," is incredibly powerful. Once you encounter. it, you're done—I mean your Life Points , that is. There are plenty of other great cards you can check out yourself, and the effects have been translated into Chinese. New users, remember to use my referral code "W" for a 25%discount. Getting to the main topic, if we're talking about the most talked-about Neo-Spacian, it's definitely N・Aqua Dolphin. Yeah, a dolphin that can talk, and even chats with you. Talking isn't unusual among Neo-Spacians, but the issue with the dolphin is that while he has a dolphin's head, he has a muscular human body from the neck down, and he speaks in such a natural tone.

Some. People are quite sensitive to this and find it uncomfortable. Plus, Aqua Dolphin’s torso is smooth, and he wears shoes; in other words, he’s only wearing shoes. Furthermore, in many scenes, he uses a condescending attitude. Combined with the aforementioned "he's only wearing shoes," there's an indescribable creepiness that leaves a deep impression . Consequently, Japanese netizens gave him the nickname "Kimodolphin"( Disgusting Dolphin) as a jab, and if you search for "Kimodolphin" on Google, the results are even more abundant than his real name. As for the card, although his effect was changed to once per turn so. he can't discard infinitely like in the anime, the current meta relies heavily on monster-type hand traps. Dolphin can check the opponent's hand and remove a low-attack hand trap, so his strategic value has increased with the environment . This behavior of looking directly at your hand and then discarding it further reinforces his "disgusting" image. Besides the six Neo-Spacians, there's another group with less presence: their juvenile forms, the Chrysalis monsters. There are six cards corresponding to six others; for instance, C-Elemental Hero glows up into N-Elemental Hero, and C-Black Panther glows up into N-Black Panther. Although C-cards can summon the N-series, there are additional conditions, so it's not just a direct.

way to bring out an extra N. The Neo-Spacians can also transform into a different kind of Fusion form. These monsters are unique as they don't require Fusion Materials. Instead, they mainly use the Normal Spell "NEX" to transform: you send a face-up Neo-Spacian to the Graveyard to Special Summon a 4-star monster from your Extra Deck that shares the same name. For example, sending N-Aqua Dolphin allows you to Special Summon Neo-Spacian Marine Dolphin. Even though I call it Marine Dolphin, this card is also treated as Aqua Dolphin on the field. Having a card treated as another is quite rare, which makes the setting very interesting. If you're having trouble sleeping and want a pick-me-up, you can go back and watch. that part of the video. This Neo-Spacian Marine Dolphin can also undergo Contact Fusion with Elemental HERO Neos to become Elemental HERO Marine Neos. Pretty cool, right? Aqua Dolphin can either Contact Fuse or transform into Marine Dolphin, and Marine Dolphin has a ton of Contact Fusion lines, but that’s as far as it goes. Only the Dolphin reached this C-level; the others only have transformations, and after that, there are no follow-up Contact forms. The remaining four Neo-Spacians can't even transform because those cards were never released—it’s very strange. Logically, NEX should be a card that allows Neo-Spacians to evolve, so all six attributes should have corresponding evolved forms. Instead, they only released the Dolphin and the Panther.

versions and then just abandoned the concept, which is a real shame. Out of the six Neo-Spacians, only two have evolution lines, and there is no third N. Speaking of "three Ns," it makes me think of No-Nut November. 當卡牌強度過高、破壞遊戲平衡時，官方會透過限制張數或禁止使用來調整環境。隨著牌組與遊戲趨勢改變，過去遭禁的卡也可能重新接受評估；若威脅已不如以往，便有機會解禁。作者以注射天使莉莉為例，說明早期看似驚人的效果，可能隨環境演變而逐漸失去威脅。若原卡仍太強，官方也可能推出較弱的相似卡作為替代。

值得閱讀的理由

  • 揭示《遊戲王5D\'s》中雷克斯·哥德溫所使用的「太陽龍」與「月影龍」背後的中南美神話背景，以及動畫中「破壞與重生」的無敵輪迴設計。
  • 詳細剖析實卡化後慘遭嚴重削弱的機制真相，說明為何曾經看似強大的無限循環在實戰中難以重現。
  • 解析官方後續推出的單卡展開補強，以及太陽龍身上至今仍令玩家與裁判稱奇、超脫「所在場所」的奇葩K社規則裁定。

摘要

動畫中的極致輪迴：光與暗的陰陽象徵

作者講述了在《遊戲王5D\'s》中，雷克斯·哥德溫兼具紅龍與暗印者的力量，象徵著融合光與暗的陰陽雙重特質。其牌組核心太陽龍因蒂與月影龍庫斯拉源自中南美神話中的太陽神與月亮女神，並搭配「泣神使者 阿斯卡托爾」與「死靈使者 蘇帕伊」等協調怪獸。在動畫中，這兩隻怪獸具備恐怖的無限輪迴互拉機制：太陽殞落則明月升起，月影消逝則太陽復甦，再加上太陽龍破壞攻擊怪獸並給予全額反傷的效果，讓主角群陷入難以擊敗的絕望循環。

殘酷的實卡化：嚴重閹割與時代眼淚

然而作者指出，這套在動畫中近乎無敵的戰術在實卡化後表現卻相當尷尬。月影龍庫斯拉變成了6星同調怪獸，雖然新增攻擊時回復生命值並保留了破壞時復活太陽龍的效果，但8星的太陽龍因蒂卻遭到全面削弱——不僅破壞反傷減半，復活月影龍的效果更被加上了必須延遲到下個準備階段的限制。此外，早期嚴苛的指定協調素材要求，加上對手只要使用除外、回手或送墓等非破壞解場手段便能輕易瓦解循環，使得這套戰術在實戰中難以發揮成效。

補強救贖與超脫常理的幽靈裁定
